meta_description: Preston Plumbing offers fast emergency plumbing repairs across Preston and Ribbleton. Same-day service, no call-out charge. Call 07940 329798 now.
hero_subhead: Burst pipe or boiler failure in Preston? We arrive within the hour, day or night, and fix it fast.
services_subhead: From emergency callouts to planned installations, we handle every plumbing job with speed and care.

services.title: Emergency Burst Pipes
services.desc: Water pouring out? We locate the leak, isolate the supply, and repair or replace the damaged section — usually within two hours. No panic, no mess.

services.title: Boiler Repairs & Servicing
services.desc: Cold radiators, loss of pressure, or no hot water? We diagnose faults fast and get your heating back on. Annual services keep breakdowns at bay.

services.title: Leaking Radiators & Valves
services.desc: Spot stains under radiators or pooling water? We replace faulty valves, bleed air locks, and reseal joints to stop the leak for good.

services.title: Bathroom & Kitchen Plumbing
services.desc: Blocked drains, leaking taps, or fitting new sinks and toilets — we handle new installations and repair work with minimal disruption.

services.title: Pipe Freezing & Thaw
services.desc: Frozen pipes cutting off your water in winter? We thaw frozen sections safely and insulate pipes to prevent it happening again next year.

services.title: Central Heating Installation
services.desc: Planning a new boiler or complete system? We design, install, and commission systems to keep your home warm and bills down.

about_pullquote: I started this because I hated waiting all day for a plumber who never showed.
about_para_1: Preston Plumbing has been serving Ribbleton and across Preston for over 15 years. We've built our reputation on showing up fast — usually within an hour — and fixing the problem the first time. Whether it's a midnight burst pipe or a planned boiler swap, we treat your home with the same care we'd give our own.
about_para_2: Hundreds of Preston families and small businesses trust us because we don't hide behind jargon or surprise you with hidden charges. No call-out fee, transparent pricing, and a guarantee on all work mean you can rely on us when things go wrong — and when you need them done right.
reviews_heading: What Preston Homeowners Say About Us

reviews.text: Had a burst pipe on a Sunday morning — called Preston Plumbing at 9am and the guy was here by 10. Fixed it in an hour, explained what happened, and charged a fair price. Can't ask for better than that.
reviews.author: David M.

reviews.text: Boiler completely died in November. They came out the next day, quoted honestly, and fitted a new system without any fuss. It's been running perfectly and the house is warmer than it's ever been. Highly recommend.
reviews.author: Christine W.

reviews.text: Called at 11pm with a leaking radiator dripping onto the kitchen floor. They answered straight away, arrived before midnight, and had it sorted by 1am. Professional, polite, and didn't break the bank. Will definitely use again.
reviews.author: Mark T.
